[Effects]
Target: yourself. Applies a Counter Heal that restores 12000 HP when attacked.
└Effect boosted by 2000 for each increase in Skill level.

[Activation Category]
Other Opening Skill (up to 2 Opening Skills of the same category can be used at once).

[Effect Duration]
For 40 seconds from the start of the battle.
